title: Dreaming of the Cosmic Serpent
description: A bearded man with long dark hair lies in bed with white pillows, covered by a dark patterned blanket, gazing toward a massive iridescent dragon with glowing golden eyes and large antlers. The dragon coils through a surreal dreamscape filled with floating castles, hot air balloons, crescent moons, and a small red-cloaked figure holding a glowing orb.
prompt: A bearded long-haired man lying awake in bed with white pillows and ornate wooden headboard, covered by a dark swirling blanket, looking at a gigantic multicolored iridescent dragon with glowing eyes and large antlers that coils through the bedroom into a dream world. Floating castles in the sky, hot air balloons, crescent moons, a small figure in red robes holding a glowing pink orb, ethereal fantasy atmosphere, detailed scales and textures.
